discription: A simple plucked sine wave sound with a fast exponential decay envelope, suitable for percussive or short melodic notes.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(0.01, 0.3), gate: gate, doneAction: 2);sig = SinOsc.ar(freq) * amp * env;Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
